annotations.title: Create a Paxmod test API key

description: Creates a working text-moderation API key with no account: 100 messages over 72 hours, standard mode, every category on. Returns api_key and claim_url; opening claim_url keeps the key in a Paxmod account. Limited to 3 keys per address per day.

name.description: Optional project name, for example the game's name.

source.description: Optional: the agent or tool asking, for example claude-code.
